cohort_extension_before_holdout: Three-seed validation clean SD was 0.0317, just above the gate. Added seeds 14 and 15 with identical averaging recipe before any fresh-holdout model evaluation; all five retained and counted, no subset selection.
hypothesis: End-of-training weight averages reduce checkpoint oscillation without adding inference networks or selecting an epoch maximum.

candidate.averaging: uniform end-of-epoch model parameters, epochs 61 through 120 inclusive
candidate.checkpoint_selection: final average only; no validation maximum selection

controls: raw feature fusion at 120 and 360 epochs

fresh_holdout.policy: Generated and published independently; no model evaluation before all candidate and control checkpoint hashes freeze. Previous 450-frame test cannot select this revision.

scope: static synthetic three-class oriented 3D detection; same evaluator and corruption family as SF-12
